Rarity.rationale: HistoryCourse.cs:15 `Rarity => RelicRarity.Event`. The sim models the rarity behaviourally, not just as a copied field: `RelicRarity.EVENT` is excluded from `RelicGrabBag._rarities`'s sim mirror (`relic_pools.py`'s `BAG_RARITIES = {Common, Uncommon, Rare, Shop}`, with an explicit comment that Event/Ancient/Starter relics never enter the bag), matching `RelicGrabBag`'s own rarity-bucket construction in the game; and it carries the same `999_999_999` non-shop-stockable merchant cost as the game's `RelicModel.MerchantCost`/`_MERCHANT_COST_BY_RARITY` table (`sts2_rl/relics/base.py`, `RelicModel.cs:304-314`). History Course is granted directly by War Historian Repy's event option on both sides (its own docstring), never drawn from a pool, so the only observable consequences of `Rarity` -- pool eligibility and shop price -- are both correctly modelled as unreachable/unbuyable on the sim side too. No divergence; not a stub.

AfterAutoPrePlayPhaseEntered.issue: Ported 2026-08-01 (round 14, R12) alongside the war_historian_repy event body; reviewer-verified line-by-line against HistoryCourse.cs (turn-1 skip, last-turn Attack/Skill lookup via CombatHistory, non-dupe filter, CreateDupe via create_clone + is_dupe/exhausts overrides, auto_play_card). ONE DOCUMENTED APPROXIMATION: 'last player turn' is matched via combat.turn rather than a per-entry TurnNumber snapshot, because sim history entries are stamped with round_number -- history.py's own documented limitation, shared by every other HappenedLastPlayerTurn caller (none ported).
